features.name: Home / Mission Control
features.detail: Bento + status-table home; Mission Control monitoring board across all projects.

features.name: Project Status (7 tabs)
features.detail: Overview/Blueprint/Business/Dev/Future/TechStack/Docs from each project's INTRO dir; route GET /project/{pid}/status.

features.name: Compliance page
features.detail: Inspector pass/fail/warn summary + manual rescan trigger.

features.name: Documentation Brain UI
features.detail: Full-text search, Plex graph, split-view reader; open/reveal endpoints for files on disk.

features.name: LLM Usage page
features.detail: Cost/token breakdowns + local-LLM savings, computed by usage_stats.py.

features.name: War Room page
features.detail: Stage 0 multi-agent text chat; proxies to Brain warroom_messages.

features.name: CoWork Dispatch page
features.detail: Approve/decline/discuss board; human queue separated from inspector volume.

features.name: Services / Tasks / Logs / Activity / Tunnels
features.detail: NSSM status, scheduled tasks, log tail, activity stream, tunnel inventory, headlines.

features.name: Task board CRUD
features.detail: Kanban backing store in data/tasks.json; SortableJS drives reorder.

features.name: Health aggregation
features.detail: Registry-driven; fans out sc/netstat/git; 30s TTL cache, threaded lock.

features.name: Contract endpoints
features.detail: Law 2 module contract for the dashboard itself.

features.name: Tunnel URL resolution
features.detail: Resolves permanent quiddityinnovations.com URLs via tunnels/static_urls.url_for_port().

features.name: Elevation config API
features.detail: Manage gsudo cache/profiles + live log levels from the UI.

features.name: 12 MCP-backed endpoints
features.detail: /api/context, /log_decision, /log_feature, /log_session, /update_project_state, /search_memory, /ecosystem_snapshot, /explain, /supersede_decision, /decide_feature, /pending_features, /override_evaluation.

features.name: Project-id resolver
features.detail: Normalises + fuzzy-matches pids so a typo returns HTTP 400 with suggestions, never a raw FK 500.

features.name: Headlines union feed
features.detail: UNION ALL across session_log, decisions, features, dispatches, compliance_log, project_state.

features.name: Agent heartbeats
features.detail: Per-agent last-seen for War Room Section 9; 1.6k+ rows.

features.name: Chroma reload hook
features.detail: Drops cached MemoryStore so out-of-process harvests are served fresh without restart.

features.name: Contract endpoints
features.detail: Reports port 9011, build, capabilities, endpoint count.

features.name: SQLite schema
features.detail: 24 tables in data/qi_brain.db: projects, decisions, features, sessions, project_state, dispatches, compliance_log, docs, doc_relationships, agents, etc.

features.name: ChromaDB memory store
features.detail: Collections qi_decisions(474), qi_features(395), qi_sessions(93), qi_docs(921) in engine/brain/qi_memory/.

features.name: Provider factory
features.detail: 5 local providers (Ollama qwen3/deepseek-r1/gemma + nomic-embed) — no cloud API for the core loop.

features.name: MCP stdio bridge
features.detail: ~150 LOC JSON-RPC stdio forwarder to :9011; registered in claude.json as qi-brain.

features.name: Background poller
features.detail: Pulls each project's state.json/status.json + git log on a schedule; file inbox at engine/brain/inbox/.

features.name: Feature propagation engine
features.detail: Scores a feature's relevance to other projects (adopt/adapt/skip); run on demand.

features.name: Doc harvester
features.detail: Walks ecosystem doc sources, catalogs into docs table (921 rows), derives doc_relationships edges (2203), embeds into qi_docs.

features.name: Knowledge graph edges
features.detail: Typed edges (doc->project, doc->doc) powering the Plex graph; 2203 relationships.

features.name: Stale / archive handling
features.detail: Federated index (files stay put); marks logs/minutes/history stale after 45 days; excludes archive snapshots.

features.name: Eight hive sub-agents
features.file: .claude/agents/hive-*.md (architect, builder, inspector, ops, scout, scribe, tester, librarian)
features.detail: Frontmatter sets name/description/model/tools; dispatched via Agent(subagent_type=hive-<role>).

features.name: Dispatch Protocol
features.detail: Trigger->agent table + workflows A/B/C + anti-patterns; main thread is the dispatcher.

features.name: Inspector (standards enforcer)
features.detail: fast/deep modes, auto-fix, files dispatches; writes compliance_log (46k+ rows).

features.name: Auto-apply pipeline
features.detail: QI_HiveApply polls dispatch_runs every 10s; Phase 1 inbox-fallback; HALT kill switch.

features.name: Inspector auto-drain
features.detail: QI_HiveInspectorDrain — deterministic, no-LLM verdicts on pending_review envelopes every 60s.

features.name: Hive ingest worker
features.detail: QI_HiveIngest — watches report inbox, forwards events into the Brain.

features.name: Elevation broker
features.detail: QI_Elevate LocalSystem daemon; watches commands/pending/*.json, runs whitelisted cmds, writes commands/completed/.

features.name: Elevate client + service helper
features.detail: run_elevated(); prefers sc.exe over nssm for start/stop (OpenService access-denied workaround).

features.name: Usage stats parser
features.detail: Parses ~/.claude/**/*.jsonl, applies public token pricing, returns daily/project/model cost + savings.

features.name: Shared logger
features.detail: Rotating-file logging used across services; config in config/logging.json.

features.name: War Room responders
features.detail: Posts/relays War Room messages; Telegram bridge + ingest from integrations/warroom_from_telegram.py.

features.name: Registry (source of truth)
features.detail: 25 project entries + port_strategy + module_interface_contract + family_taxonomy; QI.cors_origins() helper.

features.name: Compliance validator
features.detail: Checks port block, /health, naming, secrets gitignore, registry currency per project.

features.name: New-project wizard
features.detail: Registers first, scaffolds the QI standard layout, creates the FastAPI /health/version/info skeleton.

features.name: Caddy LAN reverse proxy
features.detail: QI_Caddy — one qi.local front door (subdomain->port + local HTTPS); verified, install pending.

features.name: Static named tunnels
features.detail: One named Cloudflare tunnel per product on quiddityinnovations.com; verify_named_tunnels.py.
